title: Self-intro card: name, role slot, shape cover
summary: A tiny greeting and name on light grey, a shape that slides in and swells to cover the frame, one huge bold word that shrinks to line size on blue, a role word that rolls through four titles, then a social handle.
use_when: a personal or freelancer intro for a portfolio, profile or reel opener
an 8 s card that lists several roles or services in one slot
a calm, type-only opener with one colour flip in the middle

look.type_style: grotesk, sentence case: small medium-weight words ~2.5 % H on light grey; one bold word at ~75 % W shrinking to ~25 % W; regular-weight role line ~6 % H on blue; small monospace handle ~2.5 % H in navy

sfx.event: shape swells and covers the frame
role word rolls to the next title
small icon flies across the frame

structure.shot: light grey plate: a 1-word greeting centred, replaced by a 2-word intro (lead word + bold name); a blue 5-point shape slides in from the left and swells over the frame
structure.camera: static (motion.json pan 0, zoom 0 for 0-2 s); only the shape moves
structure.motion: greeting holds f0-f20; intro lead word cuts in at f21 (no blend frame at 30 fps); name drops ~4 px from above with a fade, easings.outExpo 3 fr (f24-f27, 30 fps strip); shape enters at the left edge at f60, slides right ~50 px@320 to sit left of the line by f65, easings.outExpo; holds to f74; swells f74-f80 from ~3 % W to cover the frame, easings.inExpo 6 fr (30 fps strip)

structure.shot: diagonal blue gradient: one bold word fills ~75 % W, shrinks to line size, swaps to a regular-weight word, a second word joins and rolls through 4 role titles; a small plane icon flies across
structure.camera: static plate; the type scales (motion.json zoom -38.8 %/s in 3-4 s is the word shrink, not a camera)
structure.motion: bold word holds ~75 % W f81-f90; shrinks to ~25 % W f90-f102, easings.outExpo 12 fr; holds to f109; crossfade to the regular-weight word f109-f110 (2 fr); second word appears at f140 and the line re-centres over ~6 fr, springs.ui (overshoot not measurable); slot rolls (old word up and out, new from below with fade, 3 fr each) at f155, f170, f185: period 15 fr; icon enters bottom-left at f178, travels a straight up-right diagonal through the line and exits top-right at f192, easings.linear

structure.shot: light grey plate: a small monospace social handle centred in navy, then replaced by a second handle
structure.motion: first handle cuts in with the cut; f201-f205 first handle fades out and the second fades in with a ~3 px upward drift, easings.inOutSine ~4 fr (30 fps strip); second handle holds f205-f242

params.intro: lead word + the person's name (name in bold), one line
params.leadWord: 1 bold word that fills the frame on the blue cut, then shrinks
params.rolePrefix: first word of the role line, regular weight
params.roles: 4 role words rolled in the slot, <= 10 letters each
params.handles: 2 social handles for the close, monospace
params.colors: plate grey, blue gradient pair, navy for the handle

notes: Measured from 4 fps sheets plus 30 fps strips extracted locally (0.5, 2.0, 2.6, 3.2, 4.6, 5.6, 6.0 s). Cuts at 2.63 and 6.53 are both off-beat (0/2 within 2 fr), so cut_on_beat false. The shape cover is a mask-style reveal that ends in a real cut (cuts.json, via flash), so transition_out stays hard-cut. Rows follow the 3 shots (none > 4 s); in-shot state changes are in motion with absolute frames. Proposed terms: icon-flyby, scale-settle. SFX planned by the glue rule, not measured (music only, no VO). Star shape and gradient plate have no studio component.
